text:
marta gomez: urgent — our nanny resigned effective Fri, and i'm due back from leave Mon. any emergency process for short-term childcare or a paid overlap so I can sort a replacement?
michelle (People Ops): sorry to hear that, Marta. yes we have an emergency overlap policy and a one-time backup care stipend. two quick actions: file the Emergency Childcare Request form and ask your manager to approve temporary phased return (4hr) while you find long-term care. link: https://intranet.redwood/care/emergency-childcare
marta gomez: thanks. can stipend cover agency placement fees or overlap wages?
lina (Benefits): stipend covers placement fees up to $800 and up to 2 weeks of overlap pay (taxable). if you need an advance, request it on the same form and mark "advance requested." we'll review within 24h.
marta gomez: i'm on a dependent visa with my partnerin country. does receiving a stipend or overlap change anything for immigration paperwork?
michelle (People Ops): generally no, its treated as employer assistance. if you have any complex visa terms we can loop Legal. please flag the form if you want Legal involved.
oliver (Manager): I can approve Marta's 4hr phased return for up to two weeks. Marta, tag me on the form and i'll confirm immediately so payroll has the approval record. :+1:
care-fund-bot: Reminder: submit by EOD Thu for same-week payroll coding. Code options: "Emergency Childcare Stipend" or "Temporary Phased Return - Paid".
